meta.title: Burn local treatment, urinary catheterization, benign-lesion destruction & fixed-code singles — clean-room decision tables
meta.derivedFrom: burn-cath-lesion-fixed-cleanroom-spec.md (rule numbers cited per row as specRef)
meta.revised: 2026-09-05 — fixed-code-singles split into four single-code families (nail-trephination, nursemaid-elbow, iv-catheter-placement, nebulizer): a single family with four code-emitting gate tables is unevaluable under meta.semantics.chaining's single-entry convention (evaluation starts at the FIRST code-emitting rowLookup, so subungual.gate's wildcard row would swallow every case). Rows/bands/caps/checklists carried over verbatim; the shared singles.sameDayEm/unitCaps/doc/payerNotes tables were distributed per family (36000 gets no sameDayEm table — it has no E/M PTP edits and the sole-service gate already blocks combined encounters). See scripts/procedure-coding-schema-spike/summary-small-families.md.

semantics.rowLookup: Rows are evaluated top-down; 'when' is a conjunction of exact-equality tests on declared facts; a fact omitted from 'when' is a wildcard; the FIRST matching row wins; 'output' is opaque data returned to the caller. No expressions, no computation.
semantics.threshold: One integer fact banded into contiguous ranges by 'bands' (min/max inclusive, null = unbounded); the matching band's 'output' is returned.
semantics.unitCaps: Per-code maximum billable units per date of service; caps are absolute inputs to claim assembly, never computed.
semantics.docChecklist: All listed items are required documentation for the code; items are human-verified, not computed.
semantics.chaining: A matched row/band output whose flags contain 'proceed:<tableId>' transfers evaluation to that table (rowLookup or threshold alike); bare 'proceed' means the next code-emitting rowLookup in document order. An output with no proceed flag settles evaluation: its codes (possibly empty) are the emission.

outputConventions.codes: array of {code, units, modifiers[]} claim lines; empty array = no procedure code (E/M pathway per notes)
outputConventions.flags: blocking or advisory strings the caller must surface; 'blocked:*' means do not emit procedure codes

facts.name: burn_depth
facts.description: Deepest documented degree of the burn(s) receiving local treatment. partial_thickness = second-degree (blistering). Spec A3.

facts.name: tbsa_tenths_treated
facts.description: TBSA of the partial-thickness burn(s) treated, summed across sites, in TENTHS of a percent (4.5% = 45) — makes the 5%/10% boundaries exact. Spec A2, bespoke-code note 1.

tables.note: Round-2 policy (obvious facts assumed): the visit_type fact was removed — the initial visit is assumed for first-degree, and 16020-16030 are 'initial or subsequent' by descriptor.

output.note: Full-thickness care belongs to the debridement/grafting families and usually referral.
16000 is initial-visit-only; the initial visit is assumed.

tables.note: Value is TBSA x 10; exactly 5% (50) and 10% (100) both band to 16025; one code per session (TBSA summed upstream).

output.note: Partial-thickness treatment needs a documented TBSA.

facts.name: catheter_type
facts.description: In-and-out catheter removed at end of encounter vs catheter (e.g., Foley) left in place. Spec A8.1/A8.2.

facts.name: indwelling_insertion_complicated
facts.description: Complicated insertion technique (altered anatomy, guide wire, difficult removal plus replacement); only meaningful for temporary_indwelling. Spec A8.3/A8.4.

facts.name: purpose
facts.description: Primary purpose; specimen_collection_only = sole purpose was urine for UA/culture. Spec A9.

facts.name: payer_type
facts.description: Medicare vs all other payers. Drives 51701 vs P9612 for specimen-only straight cath. Spec A9.

output.note: Medicare: specimen-only straight cath is P9612, never 51701.
Commercial payers generally accept 51701 for sterile-specimen catheterization.
Straight cath for PVR, relief drainage, etc. — any payer.
Complicating factor must be concretely documented.

facts.name: lesion_category
facts.description: benign_other = warts, molluscum, seborrheic keratoses and other benign lesions; the other values route out of this family. Spec A12.

facts.name: lesion_count
facts.description: Exact number of lesions destroyed this session; drives the 14/15 boundary. Spec A13.

output.note: Skin tags are excluded by the 17110 descriptor.
Premalignant (e.g., actinic keratoses) use the per-lesion 17000-series.
Anogenital condyloma use site-specific destruction codes.
Method of destruction never changes the code (method-agnostic).

tables.note: Flat session codes: units always 1; the two codes are mutually exclusive; exactly 14 -> 17110, 15 -> 17111.

output.note: 17111 replaces 17110 at 15+; never report both.

facts.description: Nail plate removed/avulsed to treat the injury (routes to 11730). Spec A17.3.

facts.name: nail_bed_repair_performed

facts.name: digits_treated
facts.description: Distinct digits with subungual hematoma evacuation; digit modifiers appended by the human coder. Spec A17.5.

output.note: The repair code subsumes the evacuation on that digit.
Drainage via nail-plate removal is part of the avulsion.

tables.note: Units = distinct digits trephined; cap 2 duplicated from unitCaps; digit modifiers appended by the coder (advisory flag).

output.note: MUE caps billable units at 2; the excess denies but is appealable.

facts.name: elbow_condition
facts.description: Documented elbow condition; true_dislocation_or_fracture routes out; other = no subluxation confirmed. Spec A18.2/A18.3.

output.note: True dislocation -> 24600/24605; radial head/neck fracture -> 24650+.
Sling/splint applied as part of treatment is included.

facts.name: venous_payer_type
facts.description: Payer for the standalone 36000 claim; Medicare status B = never separately paid. Spec A19.3.

tables.note: Round-2 policy: the sole-service checkbox was removed — charting IV placement as its own procedure asserts it stood alone; the bundling rule survives in the checklist and the status-B payer note.

output.note: Reportable alone, but Medicare never pays 36000 separately (status B).
Payable per commercial contract when venous access was the sole service.

facts.name: neb_treatment_context
facts.description: Why the treatment was given; bronchodilator_for_spirometry_study = misuse of 94640; none = no treatment given. Spec A20.1/A20.3.

facts.name: neb_continuous_over_one_hour
facts.description: Continuous or back-to-back treatment exceeding one hour (routes to 94644/94645). Spec A20.2.4.

facts.name: neb_episodes_of_care
facts.description: Separate episodes of care (arrival to departure) with inhalation treatment this date; back-to-back treatments within one episode count once. Spec A20.2.

output.note: 94060 includes the bronchodilator administration; reporting 94640 for it is a misuse.
Over one hour reports 94644 (+94645), never 94640.

tables.note: One unit per episode of care; the 2nd+ same-date episode carries modifier 76; lines enumerated because the MUE caps episodes at 4.

output.note: MUE caps at 4 per date; the excess denies but is appealable.
